scope: Remove the reusable room-launch secret from public editor assets and establish server-side room-creation authority/abuse controls.
Replace the single global room/storage slot with an independent durable room identity/storage boundary suitable for more than one game.
Extend the existing production HTTPS scenario (do not add a duplicate suite) to prove no reusable secret appears in dist and two independent maps do not collide.
Return a new exact SHA with required checks; external stand and publication remain separate owner decisions.
acceptance: A new exact SHA contains no reusable server secret in downloadable assets, supports isolated independent room identities, passes the extended production HTTPS scenario and full required checks, and is handed back for independent review.

test_change_summary.scenario_risk: Production packaging, three HTTPS origins, durable room restart and the same restricted player link were not covered by the local functional suite.
test_change_summary.reuse_or_new_reason: The existing local VTT suite remains the detailed behavior coverage. One new top-level scenario is useful for the distinct production delivery path; it should be extended, not duplicated, to assert that no reusable server secret is shipped in public assets.
